description: Minecraft mod that alters the appearance of leaves & grass

releases.notes:
**Important:**
If you had any custom configs from versions 1.2.4 or earlier (or from the original Better Foliage mod) you will have to replicate them manually. As of version 2.0.0 much of the mod's configurations have changed. The old config file in the located at `config/BetterFoliage.cfg` is no longer used, and instead the mod now uses a new file located at `config/BetterFoliage_LegacyEdition.cfg`. Your old file will not be deleted, but not all configs are compatible with the new file. You can use it as a reference when replicating your custom configs or delete it. This should be the last time a config change is ever required, as the mod now keeps its own up-to-date configs in a resourcepack, separate from the player's custom configs. --- In this version, the mod has been completely rewritten from Kotlin to Java and every feature has been reimplemented, most with additional configuration options. The complete list would be too long for a changelog, but you can check out all of them in the [Features](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/wiki/Features) wiki page. Due to the language change the mod also no longer depends on [Forgelin: Legacy](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/Forgelin) or [GTNH's Forgelin](https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/Forgelin/releases). Requires [UniMixins](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/UniMixins/releases) --- ## Additions - The whitelists/blacklists of blocks have been reworked into lists of Block Filters, which offer more in-depth options on which blocks should and should not be considered valid for each of the mod's features. For more information check the [Block Filters](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/wiki/Block-Filters) wiki page. - The lists of biomes per feature have been reworked into lists of Biome Filters, which allow the valid biomes for a specific feature to be pre-configured without relying on the biome's ID, which may be different for different modpacks. For more information check the [Biome Filters](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/wiki/Biome-Filters) wiki page. - Additional block and biome filters may be added by other mods or resource packs without overriding the player's config file. These filters will 'stack' with each other in the order they are loaded. This allows resource packs to override filters from other mods / resource packs without altering other unrelated filters. For more information check out the [Resource Pack Integration](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/wiki/Resource-Pack-Integration) wiki page. - A new in-game command has been added to help with getting block or biome information for filters.
Type `/betterfoliage block` to get information about the block you're currently looking at or `/betterfoliage biome` for information about the biome you're currently in. - The mod now uses a fixed seed for its features, and no longer depends on the world seed. This means a world in MP will look the identical to the same world in SP. This seed can be changed in the mod's settings. - Soul Sand blocks can now be specified as a Block Filter. This allows Soul Particles to appear from more blocks. Compatibility for EFR's Soul Soil has been added by default. - Added a config option to toggle Biomes O' Plenty to render rounded leaves, defaulting to true. \[[#31](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/issues/31)] ## Fixes - Fixed a bug where most features would render in pitch black when using shaders and Angelica 2.0.0-alpha9 or later. \[[#28](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/issues/28)] - Improved side selection for extra leaves ambient occlusion, which should also fix a bug where leaves would sometimes render in pitch black. \[[#4](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/issues/4), [#33](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/issues/33)] - Fixed some lighting bugs where Angelica would consider Round Logs as full blocks. - Fixed some invisible face bugs with modded liquids. ...

**Important:** If you are updating from the original BetterFoliage mod or a previous version of this one (1.2.2 or earlier) you must delete the config file located at `config/BetterFoliage.cfg` and let the mod regenerate it on the next game launch for fixes to be applied. Make a backup of any settings you've changed before doing so. Requires [UniMixins](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/UniMixins/releases) and either [Forgelin: Legacy](https://github.com/LegacyModdingMC/Forgelin) or [GTNH's Forgelin](https://github.com/GTNewHorizons/Forgelin/releases).
(Use whichever one comes included in your modpack. If neither is present, I recommend Forgelin: Legacy over GTNH's Forgelin) The previous release had a regression bug with Biomes O' Plenty leaves that I missed. Thanks @Omgise for pointing it out!
Since this is a bugfix release, if you're updating from 1.2.3 you don't need to delete the config file. ## Fixes - Fix regression where custom render types would ignore the `captureShadingOnly` variable

## Additions
More options have been added to the Better Cactus configs.
The extra textures for the cactus arms and main body can be enabled or disabled separately.
Meaning that if you (like me) want to see the little small cactus arms, but not the big round texture on the cactus block itself, you can do so now.

More types of modded leafs now use the correct Falling Leaf particle VFX by default.

To give an example: Redwood leaves (from various mods), being coniferous trees, now use the same Leaf VFX texture as Spruce.
Tree scientists, feel free to yell at me in the [Issues](https://github.com/Kynake/BetterFoliage/issues?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen) if anything looks wrong (or, if you feel like it, create a texture for a new leaf type and make a PR).

## Changes
Better Cactus rendering has been changed to allow for the chance of arms appearing on each cactus side to be configurable.
Previously each cactus block would have always exactly one arm on a random cardinal direction.
Now a cactus block may have between 0 and 4 arms, with a configurable probability.

Connected Grass now ignores TerraFirmaCraft blocks, as TFC implements its own connected grass logic.

Round Logs now defaults to disabled on first install. Most people prefer the normal Minecraft logs and would've changed the config anyway.

## Fixes
Fixed cactus arms floating one pixel away from the main cactus body.
